description: Weighted readiness estimate for a transparent, source-gated HK law assistant. Percentages are engineering/product-readiness estimates, not legal validation.

gates.remaining: Scale public corpus and keep private/licensed sources out of public namespace.
Large-scale case/legislation parsing and proposition extraction.
Production embedding provider, dimension migration, and reindex safeguards.
Hybrid keyword/vector retrieval quality gate and optional reranker provider.
More verified source cards across domains and answer cross-checking at scale.
Full review promotion UI/API, audit logs, and broad golden query suite.
Cache reuse policies across more domains and stale-source invalidation tests.
Real Clerk JWT verification, tenant audit logs, and private-source retrieval QA.
